chapter_seo_title: Desolate Era Ch. 334: Ji Ning’s Romantic Vow & Lu Dongbin’s Gift
chapter_meta_description: Ji Ning and Yu Wei confess their love in the Moon and Landscape Painting. Lu Dongbin saves her with a miraculous wine, while Nine Lotos confronts her own heart.
og_title: Desolate Era Ch. 334 – A Vow Sealed With Wine
og_description: Amidst the Immortal Fortunes Assembly, Ji Ning wins the woman he loves, a legendary immortal plays matchmaker, and a rival cultivator makes a painful choice.
twitter_description: Ji Ning and Yu Wei's romance climaxes in the Moon & Landscape Painting! Lu Dongbin plays cupid with a magical wineskin.

lore_anchors.definition: One of the legendary Eight Immortals of Chinese folklore. In Desolate Era, he is a powerful Pure Yang True Immortal who delights in meddling in mortal romantic affairs.
A magic treasure used during the Immortal Fortunes Assembly to create a pocket realm where Wanxiang Adepts compete for talismans.
A deadly corrosive and venomous hand technique used by Xiamang Qi, capable of killing even immortal bodies without proper treatment.
The eighth major realm of Ki Refining, marking a cultivator who has fully mastered a Grand Dao; the highest power level present in the Grand Xia imperial palace.
A specific type of inner demon born from powerful feelings of love, attachment, or heartbreak. A cultivator must resolve it to avoid damaging their Dao-heart.
The fourth major realm of Ki Refining; the stage of the participants in the Immortal Fortunes Assembly.
A powerful noble of the Grand Xia Dynasty and the grandfather of Yuchi Xiyue (Xiyue Commandery Princess).
